title.ja: 官職録における未確認の一節
title.en: An Unverified Passage in the Directory of Officials

quote.ja: 『書記ミルテ、四時十七分、外壁に記述を残す』
quote.en: 'Scribe Milte, four-seventeen, leaves a description on the outer wall.'

mood.ja: 事実と筆跡の冷たい符合に、胸の奥が微かに軋む。
mood.en: The cold convergence of fact and handwriting causes a faint, silent ache deep within.
